## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows the convention (`feat/<name>`, `fix/<name>`, `docs/<name>`, `chore/<name>`).
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes.
- [ ] `npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build` passes.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, real tenant data or internal URLs in code, tests, fixtures or docs.
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour or the command surface changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes.
